install: set -euo pipefail; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true; if ! command -v deno >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ ! -x "$HOME/.deno/bin/deno" ]; then curl -fsSL https://deno.land/install.sh | sh -s -- -y --no-modify-path; fi; export DENO_INSTALL="$HOME/.deno"; export PATH="$DENO_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"; grep -qxF 'export DENO_INSTALL="$HOME/.deno"' ~/.bashrc || echo 'export DENO_INSTALL="$HOME/.deno"' >> ~/.bashrc; grep -qxF 'export PATH="$DENO_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"' ~/.bashrc || echo 'export PATH="$DENO_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc; if ! command -v genhtml >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -y && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y lcov; fi; deno task check; npm install --no-audit --no-fund
